svg.text: Minerva's face leads the top strip. Objects and Map are tabs. The
family row and the actions sit beside the small card as big wells;
the station shows under Earth's tab.
Your connection in one place: the network and block, your account
and what it holds, and how you're signing. Start and End Session
live here now, not on the ship.
Opened from the ship half of the top strip. The ship you're in is
always marked in yellow. The second ship and Take Control are
drawn and switched off until pilots can own two.

g.text: Game moves go through without asking.
Leftover gas comes back when it ends.
Without one, every move asks your phone.
Not yet: the Polkadot App doesn't offer it
One mind, one ship at a time
More ships come from orbital autofactories.
